source_text: (6) Στίχ. ιε΄. Γῆ τετρακοσίων διδράχμων. Σημειωτέον, ὅτι τάφου τιμή ἐστι τὰ τετρακόσια, τῷ κακωτικὴν εἶναι τὴν τετράδα καὶ ἑκατοντάδα. Καὶ ζητήσας τὰ ὅμοια ἐκ τῶν Γραφῶν εὑρήσεις.
thought_title: The four hundred didrachms as a harmful number
orientation: Origen is commenting on Genesis 23:15, where Abraham pays four hundred didrachms for a burial field.
pass_a_gloss: Verse 15. A land of four hundred didrachms. It must be noted that the four hundred are the price of a tomb, because the tetrad and the hundred are harmful. And if you seek the similar things from the Scriptures, you will find them.

choices.english: A land of four hundred didrachms
choices.why: Keeps the literal genitive construction and the glossary rendering for the coin amount.
rejected: A field worth four hundred didrachms

choices.why: Preserves the impersonal verbal adjective's force as a note to the reader.

choices.term: κακωτικὴν εἶναι τὴν τετράδα καὶ ἑκατοντάδα
choices.english: because the tetrad and the hundred are harmful
choices.why: Keeps the causal infinitive construction and the technical number terms literally.
rejected: because four and one hundred are harmful numbers
since the number four and the number one hundred are harmful

choices.term: ζητήσας τὰ ὅμοια ἐκ τῶν Γραφῶν εὑρήσεις
choices.english: if you seek the similar things from the Scriptures, you will find them
choices.why: Preserves the conditional force of the aorist participle and the literal 'from the Scriptures'.
rejected: search the Scriptures and you will find similar things
if you look for similar things in the Scriptures you will find them

pass_b_english: “A land of four hundred didrachms” (Genesis 23:15). It must be noted that the price of the tomb is four hundred, because the tetrad and the hundred are harmful. And if you seek the similar things from the Scriptures, you will find them.
